page_note: Heavily damaged page (96.8%). Content is a dialogue about prayer: a disciple asks the Apostle whether prayer benefits others, and the Apostle responds with teaching about prayer in the Manichaean ecclesial system (elect, Church, faithful Father, Son the Christ). The page is dominated by apostolic_dialogue frame (Q&A) and manichaean_ecclesial content. A faint cosmological etiology of prayer surfaces at i=19-20 ('this prayer came into being from the firsts; the gods first prayed to their Father') and at i=29-30 (the Mother glorifying/blessing) — these may preserve cosmological substrate beneath the ecclesial application. Most other segments belong to the dialogue frame or ecclesial layer.
